title: Relay key response parameters information element

fields.name: Length of Relay key response parameters
fields.description: Length of the relay key response parameters

fields.name: Key KNRP_ProSe
fields.description: 256-bit root key established between the two entities communicating using NR PC5 unicast link as defined in 3GPP TS 33.503

fields.name: Nonce_2
fields.description: 128-bit nonce value as defined in 3GPP TS 24.554

notes: The relay key response parameters information element is to transport the parameters of the key response for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay as specified in 3GPP TS 33.503
The relay key response parameters is a type 6 information element
Whether other parameters are included is FFS and will be determined by SA3
